name: Valid'.dual
statement: ∀ {t : Ordnode α} {o₁ o₂}, Valid' o₁ t o₂ → @Valid' αᵒᵈ _ o₂ (dual t) o₁ | .nil, _, _, h => valid'_nil h.1.dual | .node _ l _ r, _, _, ⟨⟨ol, Or⟩, ⟨rfl, sl, sr⟩, ⟨b, bl, br⟩⟩ => let ⟨ol', sl', bl'⟩

have_tree.body: Valid'.dual h; rwa [dual_dual, OrderDual.Preorder.dual_dual] at this⟩

have_tree.type: 2 * size l ≤ size ml + size mr + 1

name: Valid'.rotateL
statement: α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂) (H1 : ¬size l + size r ≤ 1) (H2 : delta * size l < size r) (H3 : 2 * size r ≤ 9 * size l + 5 ∨ size r ≤ 3) : Valid' o₁ (@rotateL α l x r) o₂

have_tree.name: H3p
have_tree.type: size l > 0 → 2 * (size rl + size rr) ≤ 9 * size l + 3

name: Valid'.balanceR_aux
statement: α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂) (H₁ : size r = 0 → size l ≤ 1) (H₂ : 1 ≤ size r → 1 ≤ size l → size l ≤ delta * size r) (H₃ : 2 * @size α r ≤ 9 * size l + 5 ∨ size r ≤ 3) : Valid' o₁ (@balanceR α l x r) o₂

name: Valid'.eraseMax_aux
statement: Valid' o₁ (.node s l x r) o₂) : Valid' o₁ (@eraseMax α (.node' l x r)) ↑(findMax' x r) ∧ size (.node' l x r) = size (eraseMax (.node' l x r)) + 1

have_tree.body: H.2.eq_node'; rw [this] at H; clear this

name: Valid'.eraseMin_aux
statement: α} {r o₁ o₂} (H : Valid' o₁ (.node s l x r) o₂) : Valid' ↑(findMin' l x) (@eraseMin α (.node' l x r)) o₂ ∧ size (.node' l x r) = size (eraseMin (.node' l x r)) + 1

name: Valid'.merge_aux
statement: Valid' o₁ l o₂) (hr : Valid' o₁ r o₂) (sep : l.All fun x => r.All fun y => x < y) : Valid' o₁ (@merge α l r) o₂ ∧ size (merge l r) = size l + size r

name: Valid'.map_aux
statement: α → β} (f_strict_mono : StrictMono f) {t a₁ a₂} (h : Valid' a₁ t a₂) : Valid' (Option.map f a₁) (map f t) (Option.map f a₂) ∧ (map f t).size = t.size

name: Valid'.erase_aux
statement: α) {t a₁ a₂} (h : Valid' a₁ t a₂) : Valid' a₁ (erase x t) a₂ ∧ Raised (erase x t).size t.size

name: size_erase_of_mem
statement: α} {t a₁ a₂} (h : Valid' a₁ t a₂) (h_mem : x ∈ t) : size (erase x t) = size t - 1
